purpose: VideoToolbox's Metal transfer, second step (y2s42), both files of Nord2Metal.bundle; built from the y2s41 sources, which reproduce the installed pair bit for bit. libredwoodair.dylib: Metal's private format 540 (MTLPixelFormatRGB8_420_2P: the two planes of '420f'/'420v' as ONE texture, sampled raw as Y, Cb, Cr) is the same in-place two-plane import 500 already was (PIPE_FORMAT_R8_G8B8_420_UNORM, which the Mali samples natively); a two-plane texture asked for with ShaderWrite or RenderTarget is refused by name (its planes are written as R8/RG8 textures); llvm.memset and llvm.memcpy of a length that is not a multiple of four (kernelComputeStage1 was refused for it); every compute module the library accepts is saved in /private/var/db/nord2-metal/kept when that directory exists (this transaction makes it, mode 1777, next to refused/; remove the directory to stop). Nord2Metal (redwooddrawable.m only): format 540 over '420f'/'420v'; every plain 1/2/4-channel 8/16/32-bit format the library has, over a plane whose element is the same size (53 R32Uint over 'BGRA', 25 R16Float over 'L00h', 23 R16Uint over the CbCr plane, ...). The path of format 500 that CoreAnimation uses is not touched (redwoodmetal.o is the y2s38 object). Previous files kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/*.pre-vt2; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-vt2-undo.sh.
